text.en:
The name of the municipality of Lezo, Province of Capiz, is hereby changed to Numancia, by
which name the pueblos of Numancia and Lezo, Province of Capiz, at present consolidated, shall hereafter be

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 16, 1923.
